styles.label: Culture
styles.blurb: Museums, the Arch and Forest Park institutions.

styles.label: History
styles.blurb: Gateway Arch, old courthouse and river history.

styles.label: Family
styles.blurb: Zoo, Science Center and City Museum for kids.

stays.why: Walk to the Gateway Arch, the Old Courthouse and the riverfront. Good MetroLink access.
Leafy streets, restaurants and cafés next to Forest Park and its museums.
Historic brick streets, old bars and a lively weekend scene. Short ride to downtown.
Walkable strip of shops, music venues and cheap eats; good for families and students.

food: Try St. Louis-style pizza: thin cracker crust with Provel cheese. It divides opinion, so give it a go.
Toast Ravioli is a local appetizer, usually served with a side of marinara for dipping.
Go for barbecue: ribs and pulled pork are common; ask locally for the current favorite spots.
Soulard and The Hill are good areas to wander for bars, cafés and Italian or pub food.
Budget tip: lunch specials and food trucks keep meals cheaper than dinner. Check hours on the day.
more_time: Add a Forest Park half-day: the free zoo, art museum and science center are close together.
Cross the river or drive out for a day of wineries and small-town stops; check opening days first.
Catch a Cardinals baseball game at Busch Stadium if the season fits your dates.

recommend.why: Two nights covers the Arch, Forest Park and a neighborhood or two; add a night for a ballgame or a day trip.

month_notes: January: cold, highs near 5°C and lows below freezing. Pack a warm coat.
February: still cold, highs around 8°C. Short indoor days are best.
March: milder at about 14°C but the wettest month, with around 13 rain days.
April: pleasant highs near 19°C; a good month for walking and parks.
May: warm at about 25°C with frequent rain; carry a light rain jacket.
June: hot, highs near 30°C. Plan outdoor sights for mornings.
July: the hottest month, highs near 31°C and humid. Use shade and water.
August: hot and humid like July, highs near 30°C.
September: warm at about 28°C and drier; a strong month to visit.
October: comfortable highs near 21°C and crisp evenings. Great for walking.
November: cooler at about 13°C; layer up for evenings.
December: cold, highs near 8°C with some freezing nights. Indoor sights shine.

climate_guide.summary: Humid continental climate: hot, humid summers and cold winters, with rain spread through the year.

items.title: Best time: April to May and September to October
items.text: Mild highs of roughly 19–28°C make walking and parks comfortable.

items.title: Summer is hot and humid
items.text: June to August sees highs near 30–31°C. Do outdoor sights early and take breaks indoors.

items.title: Winters are cold
items.text: December to February highs sit around 5–8°C, with nights below freezing. Bring a warm coat.

items.title: Rain in every month
items.text: Expect roughly 8–14 rain days a month, most in spring. A small umbrella helps.

items.title: Shoulder seasons are steady
items.text: April, May, September and October balance warmth and rain well for sightseeing.

items.title: What to pack
items.text: Layers for changing days, a rain jacket, and sunscreen and a hat for summer.

transit.best: MetroLink for the airport and Forest Park; walk or ride-share downtown.

modes.text: MetroLink light rail links the airport, Forest Park, downtown and Illinois. A 2-hour pass costs $3, or $4 at the airport station; a day pass is $5.
Metro buses cover the region but run infrequently. Single fare $2.
Uber and Lyft are popular. Taxis must be ordered by phone or app.
Driving is the most common way around. Useful for trips outside downtown.
Downtown is walkable. Use transit or a ride for longer hops.
